headline: OpenAI expands GPT-5.6 Luna access while improving Sol reasoning capabilities
body: OpenAI has expanded free user access to GPT-5.6 Luna and improved its GPT-5.6 Sol reasoning model, with new features including a 'Think' button designed to surface more reliable factual outputs. For healthcare AI implementations, enhanced reasoning capabilities and broader model availability lower barriers to deploying AI in clinical settings where accuracy and fact-grounding directly impact patient safety and clinical decision support. The focus on reliability addresses a critical pain point in healthcare workflows: reducing hallucinations and improving trustworthiness in EHR integration and clinical documentation tasks. Healthcare vendors and health systems should evaluate whether these improvements meet validation requirements for regulated clinical use cases, particularly in diagnostic support and evidence-based protocol recommendations.
